scene_type.description: Reserve 'mixed' for a human figure competing with architecture for attention in the same frame -- not merely a scene with more than one kind of object in it.

mixed_dominant_region.description: Only meaningful when scene_type is 'mixed'; 'null' otherwise.

suggested_title.description: A short, natural title for this sketch scene itself -- not the sketching process, not the style -- at most 8-10 words. Title Case, no trailing punctuation, no quotes. Example: 'Sunset Over the Old Harbor Bridge'.

perspective_lines.description: Optional. A flat [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...] list, 0-1000 scale, one 4-integer group per dominant real perspective/vanishing line actually visible in the photo (a building edge, sidewalk curb, railing, roofline, etc. that visibly converges toward a vanishing point). Trace each line along its real path in the photo -- never invent a line that isn't actually there. Return at most 4 lines (16 integers), strongest/most useful first. Return an empty array if the scene has no clear converging lines.
